references.text: Elaborates on the rule concerning foreigners and Passover: a resident alien must be circumcised to participate in the Passover meal
Provides regulations for foreigners who wish to celebrate Passover, requiring them to follow the Passover statutes
Confirms that there shall be one law for both Israelites and foreigners living among them
Ezekiel repeats the prohibition against uncircumcised foreigners entering the sanctuary
Paul describes the Gentiles' former alienation from the citizenship of Israel and the covenants
In Christ, believers are no longer foreigners but fellow citizens with the saints
Both are part of the same Passover legislation; verse 1 sets the scene while verse 43 defines the criteria for participants.
